explanation: Data type 'camera_frame' classified LOCAL_ONLY: Raw imagery is large, highly sensitive, and not needed off-device once features are extracted.
LOCAL_ONLY data never leaves the device regardless of battery/network/mission state.
Data type 'object_embedding' classified ENCRYPTED: Derived feature vector can re-identify what the drone observed; encrypt before it leaves the device.
Latency budget permits off-device aggregation; cloud encrypted execution selected.
Data type 'fleet_aggregate_statistic' classified AGGREGATABLE: Only the aggregate (mean/sum across drones) is useful centrally — CKKS lets the server compute it without seeing inputs.
Latency budget permits off-device aggregation; cloud encrypted execution selected.
Data type 'battery_telemetry' classified PLAINTEXT: Operationally necessary, low sensitivity, needed quickly and cheaply for fleet health dashboards.
Low-sensitivity data permitted to transmit unencrypted; routed CLOUD_PLAINTEXT.

conventional.privacyExposure: Aggregator/cloud operator sees all 20 drones' raw feature vectors individually, including each drone's exact infraAnomalyScore.

confidentialEdge.latencyMs: 53.02 ms total compute (encrypt+aggregate+decrypt; see apps/fleet/compare.ts for critical-path-only timing)
confidentialEdge.privacyExposure: Aggregator sees only ciphertext bytes and (if ever shared back) the fleet mean — never an individual drone's reading.
